title: Complete SSH lifecycle and option security
description: Verify and, where needed, fix SSH/autossh/reverse-forward command construction, destination validation, reconnect, and option sanitization.
acceptanceCriteria: Only allowlisted `-o Key=Value` SSH options are accepted; dangerous options are rejected or dropped
Command argv begins with the resolved program and never contains a stray shell/program token
Destination/host/port validation prevents shell injection and malformed remote commands
Passwords/private keys are never placed in argv, logs, events, systemd text, or diagnostics

steps.details: Add cases for ProxyCommand, LocalCommand, IdentityFile, newline/quote injection, malformed destinations, and secret redaction before production changes.
Read `config/ssh.ts`, reverse builder, runner, systemd/process code, and current SSH tests; document all argv and secret boundaries.
Apply only evidence-backed allowlist/argv/destination/lifecycle corrections, preserving autossh defaults and remote runner behavior.
Run focused security tests, custom harness, typecheck, and lint; record real SSH/VPS tests separately.

technicalNotes: SSH passwords currently travel through `SSHPASS`; preserve that boundary and never broaden shell execution.
